criteria.requirement: Add timeutils.month_range(start,stop,step=1,*,inclusive=False,month_end="clip") for actual date objects. Use absolute month arithmetic with the original start.day as anchor; clip/skip/raise explicitly controls months lacking that day, without drifting March to a February-clipped day. Support negative month steps, leap years and exclusive/inclusive bounds, reject zero/bool/noninteger step and unknown policy. Preserve existing daterange and never model a calendar month as a fixed number of days.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
